manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the metal can fits easily in hand, drop it into the basket with rounded edges, lift the basket with rounded edges with another arm.

Task description: Put the metal can with a white base, red label, and gold lid on the left into the red round basket in the center, then have the other arm lift the basket with the can inside.

Success criteria: The other arm must lift the basket containing the can so both are clearly above their starting heights. The can must remain inside, close to and touching the basket body, with no table contact. Keep the basket opening upright without excessive tilt.

## Execution tips

- When grasping the can, place the pads against the straight cylindrical side wall around the middle, with an opening slightly wider than the body. Confirm that the fingers actually surround it to avoid slipping after catching only the lid rim.
- Arched handles occupy space near the basket opening. Place the can through the clearance between them, allowing room for both can and gripper. Release near the basket bottom to reduce collisions with handles or rim and bouncing out after landing.
- To lift the basket, consider grasping the solid top section of its arched handle near the midpoint, matching the opening to the handle's cross-section and ensuring both pads make ample contact to reduce tilting from an off-center lift.
- Move the basket containing cans with gentle acceleration and deceleration, keeping its opening upward to reduce rolling or sliding out. If it must be regrasped, first let its bottom rest on the table rather than releasing while it is suspended.
